info.bio:
Eric's Trip es una banda canadiense de indie rock. Se formó en 1990 cuandó Rick White y Chris Thompson de The Forest se unieron a Julie Doiron y Ed Vaughan (remplazado posteriormente por Mark Gaudet de Purple Knight). Eric's Trip tomó notoriedad como la primera banda canadiense  que firmó con el sello discográfico independiente Sub Pop a principios de los 90s. 

Sacaron su nombre de una canción de Sonic Youth song y emularon el sonido de guitarras distorsionadas de Dinosaur Jr.

scenes.name: Más ruidoso que el rock: noise-rock de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: En los noventa los géneros de los ochenta (lo-fi, industrial, gótico, roots-rock, noise-rock, indie-pop, techno, ambient) se separan en lugar de fundirse: es la revancha de «la provincia» (el Sur, Seattle) y la década con menos géneros nuevos (grunge, post-rock, trip-hop, drum'n'bass, glitch). La influencia de Sonic Youth y Pussy Galore es la más visible: Bewitched, Boss Hog, Jon Spencer Blues Explosion (deconstrucción posmoderna del blues), Versus. El hardcore apocalíptico de Chicago: Jesus Lizard (Goat), Dazzling Killmen, Unsane. Polvo y la escuela de Chapel Hill, Come, Supreme Dicks, Tsunami, Brainiac; en Inglaterra, Gallon Drunk, Jacob's Mouse, Prolapse; en Canadá, la escuela de Halifax (Eric's Trip, Sloan, Jale).

podcast.title: Halifax Scene Contemporaries and Collaborators
podcast.body: Eric's Trip was a band from the Halifax scene, co-managed by Peter Rowan. Sloan viewed them as "cooler" and, through their Murder Records label, released a split seven-inch with them and brought them on tour as part of their effort to support the local music community. "And also our co-manager, the time Peter Rowan was also involved with managing like Eric's trip and hardship post. And we eventually put it there records as well."

xref.title: Co-Manager and Scene Figure
xref.body: Peter Rowan served as a co-manager for Sloan and was also involved in managing other bands from the Halifax scene, such as Eric's Trip and Hardship Post. His connections facilitated Murder Records' expansion to release records for these other local groups. "And also our co-manager, the time Peter Rowan was also involved with managing like Eric's trip and hardship post."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Sloan In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Halifax Music Community Support
xref.body: After gaining major label attention, Sloan made a conscious effort to support the Halifax music scene, where they felt they "knew everybody who was into cool music." They expanded Murder Records to release albums by local bands like Eric's Trip, Hardship Post, and Thrush Hermit, and brought these bands on tour to share opportunities. "But we really tried to be gracious about it and really try part of the expanding murder records and putting out other records was an effort to be a part of the community where we were all of a sudden our aspirations changed to being national or international."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Sloan In Their Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Highly Regarded Halifax Live Band
xref.body: Hardship Post was a band from the Halifax scene, co-managed by Peter Rowan, and was highly praised by Sloan members as the "best live band" and "insanely good." Sloan supported them by releasing their records on Murder Records and taking them on tour. "Eric's trip were cooler than us. But no, there were a lot of great bands in this band hardship post. They were the best live band. They were insanely good."
